_comment: Curated live-faucet directory for testnet. Edit + commit; scripts/publish-faucet-registry.sh reads this, stamps unix_ts=now, signs, publishes to IPFS. See docs/operations/runbook-faucet-registry.md for the full ceremony.
_last_seen_note: 'last_seen' is a producer-side timestamp: when the maintainer last verified this entry responds. Update per-entry as you re-verify; leave stale entries with old last_seen until you're ready to remove them (wallet UI badges old entries).
